title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG The Regulation of Tribe Pharaoh's Servant PSV-027 1st Edition...
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for any serious collector. With its stunning design and powerful abilities, The Regulation of Tribe is a true gem in the Pharaoh's Servant set.

Featuring a Trap-Continuous card type and a Card Number of PSV-027, this 1st Edition card is a Common rarity and comes in the Color attribute. Perfect for players and collectors alike, this card is sure to impress and make a great addition to any collection. Don't miss your chance to own this amazing card!
